methodology: Ground truth computed from token_price_history (independent, always-on collector, not part of the tournament simulation) for the exact window 2026-07-20 02:08:00 to 03:09:00. A token 'pumped' if peak price >= 10% above its first observed price in the window. Precision/Recall computed only against tokens for which token_price_history had at least 2 real ticks in the window (most flagged tokens, especially legacy/stale ones from cycle 1, had no ticks and are excluded, not counted as negatives).
note: The three Momentum Hunter variants share identical precision/recall because entry quality is a property of the ENTRY engine (Momentum Hunter's scoring), not the exit strategy - this is expected and correct, not an error.
